## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] No em-dashes or en-dashes added
- [ ] `node --test` passes
- [ ] If record structure changed, `DECISIONS.example.md` and the linter were updated to match
- [ ] If behavior changed, `CHANGELOG.md` has an `Unreleased` entry
- [ ] Backward compatibility considered (a repo valid under the last release stays valid, or the break is called out)
